notes.title: Patch 1.0.17
notes.notes:
Fixes

 Mouse sensitivity now loads correctly after dying or loading the game.
 The "charge the monorail battery" event would trigger if the player approached the power room without using the vehicle.


Additions


 New application icon.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.15
notes.notes:
Fixed sounds that didn't respect audio channels (volume couldn't be controlled).
 Changed the path of some enemies.
 Improved the adaptive difficulty system.
 Made some minor improvements.
 Optimized some resources.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.14
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug in the translation within the thermal control room.
 Fixed an issue when unlocking one of the achievements.
 Fixed a bug when reloading the level after dying.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.12
notes.notes: Possible fix for a reported bug in the maintenance room: during the cinematic while charging the battery, the scene freezes.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.11
notes.notes:
The containment room event has been balanced (it gets easier with each failure).
 Some minor changes.
